look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST: Look for small lavender tubular florets gathered into tight secondary clusters of several tiny heads, typically subtended by three leaflike bracts. Check alternate, coarsely toothed leaves that become clasping on the stem; photograph here shows florets, not the complete bract/leaf diagnosis.
